monster.hedge-goblin.lore: Employed by nobody, stationed at a hedge nobody owns, and fiercely proud of both facts.
monster.cranky-boar.lore: Has been cranky since one specific picnic, and nobody has ever thought to ask him about it.
monster.twig-sprite.lore: Weighs less than a letter and has still been described, by three separate rangers, as 'a lot'.
monster.bramble-wolf.lore: Grew a coat of thorns for protection and can now never be scratched behind the ears, which was not the plan.
monster.mushroom-truant.lore: Is meant to be standing in the ring with the other mushrooms; is instead out here, doing this, badly.
monster.apprentice-poacher.lore: Two years into a four-year apprenticeship and still lists 'ran away very fast' as his practical skill.
monster.bee-wizards-swarm.lore: The Bee-Wizard retired ages ago; the swarm never got word and keeps teaching his old lesson plan to whoever walks past.
monster.tobbin-the-toll-troll.lore: Itemises every invoice — bridge access, ambience, emotional labour — and staples the copies, because he is not an animal.
monster.scarecrow-awoken.lore: Woke up, read the job description properly for the first time, and had the whole field unionised by lunch.
monster.field-bandit.lore: Robs travellers on the honour system, which is going roughly as well as you would expect.
monster.rogue-ram.lore: Left the flock over a disagreement about gates and has spent every day since proving his point to nobody.
monster.crow-conspiracy.lore: Meets at dusk, keeps minutes, and has never once voted on anything that wasn't corn.
monster.turnip-golem.lore: Assembled from the harvest nobody wanted, and quietly furious about being classed as second-rate produce.
monster.hedge-witch.lore: Charges two eggs for a blessing and four for a curse, because curses require follow-up visits.
monster.tax-collector.lore: Carries a ledger, a wax seal and a very official hat, and has never been asked to produce a single document behind any of them.
monster.old-man-mangel.lore: Forty years guarding a mill that stopped turning in year six, out of a stubbornness that has slowly become a kind of love.
monster.pollen-imp.lore: Exists to make you sneeze, considers this a calling, and has been told repeatedly that a calling is a different thing.
monster.thorn-dancer.lore: Eleven years of training in a discipline with no rivals, no audience and no name.
monster.honey-slime.lore: Has ended more chases by being accidentally sat in than by anything it has ever done deliberately.
monster.petal-charmer.lore: Can persuade a rose to recite poetry, and cannot persuade it to stop, which is the part the pamphlet leaves out.
monster.hiveguard-drone.lore: Guards a hive with forty-one other guards and one extremely small door, and takes the rota seriously regardless.
monster.garden-gnome-ultra.lore: The Ultra designation was awarded at a ceremony he organised, catered and attended alone.
monster.wasp-baroness.lore: Holds firm views on zoning, hedge height, and precisely who authorised that birdbath.
monster.the-overgrown-groundskeeper.lore: Kept these gardens for sixty years, then let them keep him, and honestly the roses have never looked better.
monster.shade-lurker.lore: Lurks in a shape that used to belong to somebody, and still flinches when it hears that somebody's name.
monster.timber-ghoul.lore: Was a woodcutter for thirty years and is now, in every sense that matters, timber.
monster.watchfire-wisp.lore: Still lighting the signal for a garrison that marched out ninety years ago and never sent word back.
monster.owlbear-cub-sitter.lore: Minds eleven cubs that are not hers, on a schedule she never agreed to, and would dearly like one afternoon off.
monster.web-matron.lore: Runs a tidy web, a tight household, and a guest list that you are currently on.
monster.deserter-ranger.lore: Abandoned a post that was disbanded the following week, a fact he has decided not to look into.
monster.moss-troll.lore: Stood still so long the surveyors filed him as terrain, and he has stopped bothering to correct them.
monster.the-toll-trolls-lawyer.lore: Represents Tobbin on retainer, bills in half-hours, and has never lost a case because nobody has ever brought one.
monster.dock-rat-king-let.lore: A king in title only, of one dock, in part, on alternate Thursdays.
monster.brine-zombie.lore: Pickled past all recognition and still turning up for shifts at a fishery that burned down two winters ago.
monster.gull-tyrant.lore: Rules the entire waterfront by sheer volume, and maintains that the fish were unattended.
monster.smuggler-first-mate.lore: Nineteen years as first mate under four captains, none of whom she liked and all of whom she buried.
monster.tidecaller.lore: Calls the tide in twice daily and takes full credit, a claim the moon has long since stopped disputing.
monster.barnacle-brute.lore: Carries half a shipwreck on his back and politely declines every offer to help him set it down.
monster.lighthouse-poltergeist.lore: Trims and lights the lamp every evening without fail; nobody has had the heart to mention that the lighthouse fell over.
monster.captain-undertow.lore: Went down with his ship on principle, and has been waiting ever since for somebody to come and call it brave.
monster.dust-devilkin.lore: A small tantrum that learned to travel, and has now been travelling for the better part of a century.
monster.sun-baked-bandito.lore: Robs the same three roads on a strict rotation, largely so that none of them feel neglected.
monster.cactus-shambler.lore: Spent two centuries growing those spines and expects them admired at some length before anything else happens.
monster.vulture-auger.lore: Reads the future in the leavings of the past, and is correct slightly too often to be good company.
monster.mesa-stalker.lore: Will follow a traveller nine miles without ever attacking, which everyone agrees is somehow worse.
monster.clay-colossus.lore: Baked, cracked, patched and rebaked by hands long gone, and still walking the patrol route they set for it.
monster.mirage-twin.lore: Insists that it was standing here first, and produces you as its evidence.
monster.sheriff-of-nowhere.lore: Elected by four voters, three of whom were him, in a township that has since blown clean off the map.
monster.ash-revenant.lore: Rose out of the ash over unfinished business and can no longer recall which business it was.
monster.cinder-hound.lore: Still runs the perimeter it was trained to run, though the wall it guarded is now a smudge on an old map.
monster.monument-golem.lore: Carved to commemorate a great victory, and now the last thing anywhere that remembers which side won it.
monster.bone-chanter.lore: Knows every name that fell on this field and sings them nightly, in order, without once stopping for breath.
monster.grief-wraith.lore: Feeds on sorrow, which in a place this well stocked is less predation than housekeeping.
monster.blackglass-duelist.lore: Fought the last honourable duel in the Reach, won it cleanly, and has not managed to leave the spot since.
monster.ash-choked-giant.lore: Took one breath during the burning and has spent two hundred years trying to finish exhaling.
monster.the-last-standard-bearer.lore: The banner has no name left on it and the war went unrecorded, and he has still never let it touch the ground.
monster.magma-whelp.lore: Hatched in a furnace, taught nothing by anybody, and doing remarkably well all things considered.
monster.obsidian-sentry.lore: Cooled into position eight centuries ago and has been interpreting the order 'hold' very generously ever since.
monster.fire-cultist.lore: Joined for the robes, stayed for the singing, and tries not to dwell on the rest of the schedule.
monster.lava-leaper.lore: Eleven thousand flawless jumps, and everyone in the caldera still only ever brings up the one.
monster.smoke-shade.lore: Everything it has ever tried to say arrives as a cough, and it has begun to take that personally.
monster.basalt-ogre.lore: Quarried himself new arms out of the cliff face when the old ones wore through, and considers this ordinary upkeep.
monster.war-drum-imp.lore: Keeps the marching beat for an army that stopped marching, and cannot be told, and will not stop.
monster.kiln-marshal-vorr.lore: Runs the great forges on a schedule so exact that the mountain has started erupting punctually out of respect.
monster.frost-wight.lore: Sat down for a moment in a storm some years ago, and is technically still resting.
monster.icicle-lancer.lore: Reforges its lance each morning out of whichever roof it slept under the night before.
monster.blizzard-hare.lore: Six pounds of animal that has outrun three avalanches and one extremely embarrassed ranger.
monster.rime-chanter.lore: Sings the cold into staying, which the cold appreciates, being otherwise entirely unthanked.
monster.frozen-sentinel.lore: Was posted to watch the stair for a single night, and the night has been going on for some time.
monster.avalanche-spirit.lore: Has exactly one idea, performs it perfectly, and needs roughly a century of quiet between shows.
monster.aurora-wisp.lore: Lovely, apparently harmless, and the reason this summit has its own word for 'pleasantly lost'.
monster.warden-of-the-white-stair.lore: Counts every climber up and every climber down, and the two numbers have not matched once since she took the post.
monster.pale-courtier.lore: Bows to precisely the depth your standing deserves, which is how most visitors first learn what their standing is.
monster.gloom-herald.lore: Announces arrivals that have not happened yet, and is never wrong about them, only early.
monster.dusk-knight.lore: Sworn to a house whose name was struck from every record, including, eventually, his own memory of it.
monster.star-eaten-scholar.lore: Read one page further than the index advised, and now keeps excellent notes on a subject nobody can safely be told.
monster.veil-assassin.lore: Contracted three centuries ago, still en route, and has never yet been late for anything.
monster.twilight-mass.lore: Was a crowd once; the individual opinions have since been resolved.
monster.lantern-snuffer.lore: Walks ahead of the procession putting out every light it passes, because it is a job, and someone has to hold it.
monster.herald-of-the-pale-king.lore: Delivers the invitation, waits politely for your answer, and has never once needed to hear one.
